question: Which Mahāvidyā identity and smoky attributes are ascribed to the goddess in this enumeration?
premises: The name Chinnamastā identifies a specific Mahāvidyā goddess.
The epithets mahā dhūmā attribute a great smoky quality to her.
The epithet dhūmra vibhūṣaṇā attributes smoke-dark adornment to her.
inference: The verse enumerates the goddess as Chinnamastā, characterized by great smokiness and smoke-dark adornment.
uncertainties: Whether mahā and dhūmā function as a single compound epithet or as closely associated separate descriptors is not fully explicit from tokenization alone.
plain_english: She is Chinnamastā, greatly smoky, and also adorned with smoke-dark ornaments.
